# World modifier vocabulary, extracted from the game's own metadata.
#
# Source: assembly_valheim.dll from valheim_server_Data/Managed/, Valheim
# l-1.0.7 (network version 39), downloaded by the lloesche/valheim-server
# image's SteamCMD bootstrap. Enum members read out of the .NET metadata
# tables, not transcribed from documentation.
#
# Why this file exists: the -modifier flag is parsed with
# Enum.TryParse<WorldModifiers> and Enum.TryParse<WorldModifierOption>, both
# case-insensitive. A misspelled value does not fail the server — it logs and
# carries on with the setting unapplied. So the spellings are load-bearing and
# a Valheim update that renames one has to fail a test here, not surface as a
# server that quietly ignores its own difficulty settings.
#
# Regenerate: docker cp the assembly out of a booted container and read the
# TypeDef/Field tables (python dnfile). See the commit that added this file.

[WorldModifiers]
Default
Combat
DeathPenalty
Resources
Raids
Portals

[WorldModifierOption]
Default
None
Less
MuchLess
More
MuchMore
Casual
VeryEasy
Easy
Hard
VeryHard
Hardcore
Most

# -setkey names. GlobalKeys mixes server options with world progress; the
# NonServerOption member is the sentinel that divides them, so everything
# below it in declaration order (defeated_eikthyr and friends) is progress
# state and not a setting. Only the members above it are listed here.

PlayerDamage
EnemyDamage
WorldLevel
EventRate
